Role Summary
We're hiring a Project Director or Project Manager to lead ground-up delivery of our Midwest data center campuses. The sites are a 100 MW campus in the Kansas City area and 50 MW+ campuses in the St. Louis area and Canton, OH. Reporting to the VP of Development, you'll represent DAMAC as the owner. You'll lead general contractors, MEP trades, utilities, equipment vendors, and design teams from preconstruction through commissioning and turnover. You'll own schedule, budget, safety, and quality, and make sure each facility is delivered on time, on budget, and to hyperscale standards.
Key Responsibilities

  • Lead full-lifecycle, ground-up delivery of data center campuses: site development, shell and core, MEP fit-out, and commissioning through turnover.
  • Represent the owner in managing general contractors and trade partners, holding them to schedule, cost, quality, and safety commitments.
  • Own the master project schedule. Drive critical-path planning, look-ahead schedules, and recovery plans.
  • Manage project budgets, cost reporting, change orders, and forecasting. Report to executive leadership.
  • Manage procurement and delivery of long-lead equipment: generators, switchgear, UPS, transformers, chillers, CRAH/CRAC units, and liquid cooling systems.
  • Coordinate with utilities on power delivery, substations, interconnection, and energization timelines.
  • Oversee design reviews, RFIs, submittals, and constructability reviews with architects and engineers.
  • Drive Level 1–5 commissioning with Commissioning Agents, through integrated systems testing (IST) and handover to operations.

Title: Senior Mobile Systems Engineer
Location: Onsite (Burlingame, Sunnyvale, MPK or NYC)
Duration: 12 months
Compensation: $59 – $79
Work Requirements: US Citizen, GC Holders or Authorized to Work in the U.S.

Senior Mobile Systems Engineer
 
Summary

  • Design and develop software systems connecting iOS/Android mobile applications, wearable devices, and distributed backend services.
  • Build high-performance mobile applications using Kotlin or Swift, with a strong focus on asynchronous and concurrent programming.
  • Troubleshoot complex multithreading issues, including race conditions, deadlocks, thread safety, and resource ownership.
  • Optimize CPU utilization, memory consumption, latency, and overall system reliability.
  • Design scalable client-server architectures and improve software performance across interconnected systems.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to deliver reliable software solutions for company wearable technology ecosystem.

 
Must-Have Skills

  • Kotlin or Swift
  • iOS / Android Mobile Development
  • Client-Server Architecture
  • Distributed Backend Systems
  • Asynchronous Programming
  • Multithreading & Concurrency
  • Race Conditions, Deadlocks & Thread Safety
  • Memory Management & Resource Ownership
  • System Architecture & Design
  • Performance Optimization (CPU, Memory, Latency & Reliability)

 
Nice-to-Have Skills

Role: IT Project Manager

Position Summary
The IT Project Manager will play a critical role in improving execution, scalability, and operational maturity across the IT organization. Reporting directly to the CIO and supported by the Corporate PMO, this role partners closely with business leaders, IT leadership, and external vendors to plan, deliver, and operationalize technology initiatives.

This is a hands-on, problem-solving role suited for an individual with a strong "fixer” mindset—someone who can bring structure where it doesn't yet exist, stabilize delivery, and progressively introduce fit-for-purpose standards, tools, and playbooks without creating bureaucracy.

In practice, this role operates as a delivery leader and internal chief of staff for the CIO, balancing project execution, change management, vendor coordination, and process improvement across IT.
